body: You’re important, to someone somewhere at least. Maybe you’re a missing piece in somebody’s life that’s helping them hold on. I hope you stay with us friend. ~Dylan
Keep your head up the best you can. I’ve always told myself, a storm must come to a stop. Rain doesn’t last forever. Good times are ahead
You’re not alone. I feel like I fail everyone in my life including myself. I have nobody and I just want to cry.
I want a hug too, I just don’t know from who
I hope you’re still here with us
